d: Burdened with the Amulet of Kinks and breasts most divine, young knight Percival Amberglow must reach Weynaughty Abby. Yet lustful demons and horny monsters from the realm of Booblivion rise to tempt and thwart him. His blade — thick, throbbing, ever eager — is the only hope of the land of Aurelion. The path is hard… and so is he.
n: [Western] BOOBLIVION: Perci and the Amulet of Kinks
